senses.gloss:
Ciṭṭayarāmabhadra
popularly known a. Kalikāla Rāmacandra; belonging to Bhūtanātha family, patron of Alaṅkāra Dīkṣita (a. of C. on Śivasahasranāmastotra, TCD. 1121).
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 399b an. II. p. 181b.

Ciṭṭibhaṭṭa
father of Tippābhaṭṭa (a. of Lakṣaṇarāji. ny. TD. 6577). [Page033-b]

Ciṭṭubhaṭṭa
of Kauṇḍinyagotra; a Yājuṣa an. father of Ākillapalli Rāmavidvat (a. of Bhāvadīpikā. jy., MT. 1935).
